items.name: HueGrid
items.tagline: A no-code shader design tool for the web — design the visual, walk away with the code.
items.headline: A no-code shader design tool for the web — design the visual, walk away with the code.
items.problemBody: WebGL and shader programming are powerful but impenetrable for non-technical designers. HueGrid bridges that gap by letting anyone create and tweak real-time visual effects directly in the browser — no code required.
